name: verdict
description: Outcome markets on Hedera: HTS outcome tokens priced by a SaucerSwap pool, settled by a Chainlink feed and resolved by the Hedera Schedule Service with no keeper.

sections.title: See live testnet markets with nothing configured

steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000. The reference deployment on Hedera testnet is committed, so markets load before you deploy anything.

steps.label: Generate or import a deployer account

steps.text: Then follow README.md, section Deploy your own, to create and seed a first market.
